faqLeft.q: What engine does the Mercedes SLK200 use?
faqLeft.a: It depends on the year. From 1996 to 2004 (R170), the SLK200 used the M111 2.0‑litre four‑cylinder petrol engine. From 2004 to 2016 (R171 and R172), it switched to the M271 four‑cylinder petrol unit — a different engine entirely. Send us your registration and we'll confirm which one your car has.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Mercedes SLK200 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,200, for either engine code. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed‑price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my SLK200?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm whether you have the M111 or the M271 before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild M111 SLK200 engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We service the M111 to the same standard as our other rebuilds, replacing worn components as needed.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild M271 SLK200 engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace the timing chain, timing gears, and gaskets as standard on every M271 rebuild, addressing the known timing chain stretch and balance shaft issues.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used SLK200 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low‑mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my SLK200 if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an SLK200 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3‑5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most SLK200 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12‑month unlimited‑mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.
